title: Exactly 18 credits is incorrectly rejected
fix: Change the total comparison from <18 to <=18.

title: Only some prerequisites incorrectly allow registration
Positive dues up to Rs. 1000 do not block registration
steps: Use default decision fixture (docs/cases.json) and set outstanding_dues=1. Call registration_decision.
fix: Change the dues threshold from >1000 to >0.

title: A full course is registered instead of waitlisted
steps: Use default decision fixture; set capacity=2 and enrolled=2. Call registration_decision. Calling register_course also incorrectly raises enrollment to 3.
fix: Use enrolled == capacity; validation already excludes over-capacity states.

title: Withdrawal does not reduce course enrollment
steps: Student has CS201 registered, 6 credits; CS201 has 3 credits, capacity=2 and enrolled=1. Call withdraw_course.
actual: True; course removed, credits=3, enrolled remains 1
fix: Subtract one from course.enrolled on successful withdrawal.
